goal: Turn an authorized Paravoxia scene intent into a signed, implemented, evidenced, independently reviewed, cohesive audiovisual experience through peer story, score, and cinematography direction without self-approval or hidden context.

inputs.description: The requested scene, chapter, recut, or audiovisual quality outcome.
The repository boundary containing current authority, canon, runtime, and evidence.
The beat, connected sequence, chapter, or approved visual surface.
The current checkpoint, protected paths, allowed mutations, and publish boundary.

roleContracts.title: Human Taste Scope And Publish Approver

gates.title: Human and machine production authority locks agree and hashes are current
Story intent is grounded in shipped truth, hashed current-cut evidence, and player causality
Score and cinematography treatments are substantive and independently formed
All peer lanes exchanged notes and blocking objections are dispositioned
One scene contract revision is complete and signed by all directors
Authorized implementation and static checks pass
Flow, exact anchors, probed raw media, typed evidence, variants, reset, and performance proof are complete
Story, score, cinematography, blind audience, and synthesis reviews are complete
Every repair either stays inside the signed contract or returns through a new contract revision and three fresh signatures
No unresolved critical, high, or unaccepted material medium creative defects remain
Creative cohesion score and category floor pass the selected run profile
Human taste is approved whenever the selected profile or defects require it
Creative run artifacts are substantive, independent, evidenced, and complete

steps.title: Lock Human And Machine Production Scope
Capture And Hash Current Shipped Cut Before Creative Treatment
Frame Story Intent And Shipped References
Compose Independent Score Treatment
Author Independent Cinematography Treatment
Chapter Director Reviews Both Peer Treatments
Score Director Reviews Both Peer Treatments
Cinematography Director Reviews Both Peer Treatments
Chapter Director Responds To Both Peer Note Sets
Score Director Responds To Both Peer Note Sets
Cinematography Director Responds To Both Peer Note Sets
Compile Director-Authored Notes Responses And Dissent Without Rewriting Them
Synthesize Frozen Shared Scene Contract From Dispositioned Director Work
Chapter Director Signs Narrative And Agency Contract Lane
Score Director Signs Musical And Synchronization Contract Lane
Cinematography Director Signs Visual And Camera Contract Lane
Assemble Three Independently Authored Signatures Without Substitution
Implement Signed Scene Contract
Capture And Hash Raw Audiovisual Flow Frame Audio Variant Reset Performance And Typed Evidence
Run Independent Story And Agency Audit
Run Independent Score Continuity Audit
Run Independent Cinematography Continuity Audit
Run Blind First-Time Review From Raw Intent-Free Audiovisual Evidence
Critique Reviews And Compile One Canonical Defect Register Without Flattening Dissent
Judge Cross-Domain Scene Cohesion Against The Canonical Defect Register
Chapter Director Directs Narrative Agency And Canon Repairs
Score Director Directs Music Mix And Cue Repairs
Cinematography Director Directs Shot Lens Palette And Render Repairs
Record No-Repair Closure Or Route Repairs Through The Current Signed Contract Or A Full Triad Re-Contract
Append Contract Defect Score Evidence And Repair Lineage To The Iteration Ledger
Integrate Director-Routed Repairs Against The Current Signed Contract
Record Headed Human Taste Scope And Exception Decision When Required
steps.activationCondition: run-profile.approval.humanTasteApproval.required == true || defects.requiresHumanTaste == true || defects.hasAcceptedException == true || production.releaseCandidate == true

steps.title: Audit Creative Run Artifact Quality
Record Run Summary And Durable Lessons

stopConditions.description: Creative score, artifact quality, headed human taste, and lessons gates pass; the run is ready for a separate publish decision.
The requested mutation exceeds current production, canon, protected-path, or publish authority.
A material taste, scope, canon, exception, or publish decision cannot be inferred safely.
Repair loops or score-stall policy are exhausted with blocking defects or incomplete evidence.

qualityQuestions: Do story, score, image, and player control express one event?
Is every material decision grounded in current shipped evidence and authority?
Did each director challenge both peer lanes and sign one contract revision?
Did blind perception match intent at the intended loudness?
Are focal subject, palette, lens, score, and state continuity preserved across adjacent scenes and variants?
Did exact-anchor, reset, performance, and headed taste evidence prove the result?
Is all dissent, repair, exception, and learning durable and inspectable?
